_doc: Engine registry for SIVS routing. Machine-read (JSON, not YAML) because the package is zero-dependency and needs a programmatic loader for pool-disjointness enforcement. Each engine has: type (cli | openai-compat), vendor (the model provider — the unit of independence), pool (vendors this engine may draw from), and optional experimental flag. Pool-disjointness rule: a Verify engine's vendor must NOT appear in the Implement engine's pool, so the model that checks work never shares a provider with the model that produced it.

fugu.note: Experiment-only. Access via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; keys env-only, never logged.
